cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Still a Good Sign
cards.instruction: Treat every awkward or disappointing interaction as proof that the connection remains alive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Our first dinner since the breakup, and you still groan at my waiter joke. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. You remembered. We've still got our little traditions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we eat in silence? I don't want another awful joke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You still know how to ask me for what you need. I'll order dessert so we have time.

mechanism: A manages a post-breakup dinner by accommodating B wish for fewer jokes, interpreting each unwelcome response as evidence of continued intimacy.
confusable: Unlike generic cheerfulness, A treats this very disappointment as proof of connection; borrowed authority changes the dinner conversation to keep B present.
comparison: A face-to-face meal and requested silence differ from repeated cancellation and release of future Fridays.
seedUse: Use D92-a waiter joke/remembering/silence and S02-b adopting B preferred interaction while maintaining an assured host role.
